text: Whenever an Island is tapped for mana, its controller may add an additional {U}. If that Island is snow, its controller may add an additional {U}{U} instead. Spend this mana only to pay cumulative upkeep costs.
failing_piece: its controller may add an additional {U}.
note: drilled: "its controller adds an additional {U}" with the spend restriction compiles (C5-W-snw-1, C5-W-snw-3), "Whenever you tap an Island for mana, you may add an additional {U}" compiles (C5-W-snw-7), the spend restriction compiles (C5-W-snw-5); the optional addition by the tapped land's controller fails (C5-W-snw-2, C5-W-snw-6): that player, not Snowfall's controller, chooses (a mana ability trigger, CR 605.1b, 106.12a). Second piece: "If that Island is snow, its controller [may] add[s] an additional {U}{U} instead." fails (C5-W-snw-4): a condition on the tapped land replacing the amount (ruling: the extra mana is blue whatever the Island makes)

failing_piece: it gets +N/+N until end of turn for each {B} or {R} spent this way.
note: drilled: the trigger "Whenever ~'s cumulative upkeep is paid" compiles (C5-W-bal-1, C5-W-bal-3); "for each {B} [or {R}] spent this way / to pay it" fails (C5-W-bal-2, C5-W-bal-6), and counts of mana of given colors spent fail elsewhere too ("for each {B} spent to cast it", C5-W-bal-7, C5-W-bal-8; "for each {R} spent to activate this ability", C5-W-bal-4, C5-W-bal-5), while Bladecoil Serpent's "for each {U}{U} spent to cast it" and "for each mana from a Treasure that was spent to cast this spell" (Spoils of the Hunt) compile: the mana of given colors spent on one payment, here the cumulative upkeep payment (CR 702.24a, 601.2h)

If you do, add three mana in any combination of its colors and put it into your hand. If you don't reveal it, put it into your hand.
failing_piece: You may reveal that card if it has three or more colored mana symbols in its mana cost.
note: drilled: "At the beginning of your first main phase" compiles (C5-W-om-2) and "You may reveal that card if it's a creature card. If you do, ..." compiles (C5-W-om-7); the mana-symbol count fails as a condition (C5-W-om-1, C5-W-om-14, C5-W-om-15; Charmed Pendant's "for each colored mana symbol in the milled card's mana cost" compiles since cards4-costs-mana-replacements; ruling: hybrid symbols count). Then "add three mana in any combination of its colors" fails (C5-W-om-11; "in any combination of colors" compiles, C5-W-om-17; "one mana of any of that card's colors" fails, C5-W-om-16, Chrome Mox's "the exiled card's colors" compiles) and "If you don't reveal it" fails where "If you don't" compiles (C5-W-om-12, C5-W-om-13). Three small pieces (ruling: not a mana ability, it uses the stack)

text: If an opponent who controls at least as many lands as you do would put a land onto the battlefield, that player instead puts that land onto the battlefield then sacrifices a land of their choice.
failing_piece: If an opponent who controls at least as many lands as you do would put a land onto the battlefield, that player instead puts that land onto the battlefield then sacrifices a land of their choice.
note: drilled: fails without the condition (C5-W-leq-1, C5-W-leq-5) and with a simpler result ("they put it onto the battlefield tapped instead", C5-W-leq-7; "If a land would enter under an opponent's control, it enters tapped", C5-W-leq-6, while the static "Lands your opponents control enter tapped" compiles, C5-W-leq-8); the trigger form compiles (C5-W-leq-3), with "more lands than you do" failing where "than you" compiles (C5-W-leq-10). A replacement of a player's action of putting a land onto the battlefield however it happens (rulings: played or put by an effect, under any player's control; the player may sacrifice that same land; with a land's own enters replacement the controller orders them, CR 616.1) with a follow-up sacrifice (CR 614.1a); Vorinclex's "If an opponent would put one or more counters ..., they put ... instead" is the same player-action shape

text: {N}: The next time you would draw a card this turn, ~ deals N damage to any target instead.
failing_piece: The next time you would draw a card this turn, ~ deals N damage to any target instead.
note: drilled: untargeted results compile ("each opponent loses 2 life instead", "deals 2 damage to each opponent instead", "you gain 2 life instead": C5-W-wow-4, C5-W-wow-5, C5-W-wow-2); a targeted result fails ("any target", "target player", either word order: C5-W-wow-1, C5-W-wow-3). The target is chosen as the ability is activated (CR 115.1c), as for the targeted next-time redirections that compile (Glarecaster, Mirrorwood Treefolk, General's Regalia, Soltari Guerrillas; Mirrorwood's ruling: an illegal target by then gets nothing redirected); no rule or ruling chooses it when the replacement applies, so this is not a one-off: record the reading in the interpretation register. Ruling: with several Words shields the player picks which applies to each draw

text: If a player would draw a card, they reveal it instead. Then any other player may pay N life. If a player does, put that card into its owner's graveyard. Otherwise, that player draws a card.
failing_piece: If a player would draw a card, they reveal it instead.
note: drilled: "they reveal the top card of their library instead" and the follow-up "Then that player draws a card" compile (C5-W-zur-7, C5-W-zur-12); "they reveal it instead" (the card they would draw) fails (C5-W-zur-1). Second piece: "Then any other player may pay N life. If a player does, put that card into its owner's graveyard. Otherwise, that player draws a card." fails in the replacement and on a neutral card (C5-W-zur-2, C5-W-zur-3, C5-W-zur-11, C5-W-zur-5, C5-W-zur-6, C5-W-zur-8, C5-W-zur-9): Dash Hopes' "Any player may pay 5 life. If a player does, ..." compiles (C5-W-zur-10, C5-W-zur-13) and "You may pay 2 life. If you do, ... Otherwise, ..." compiles (C5-W-zur-14); "any other player" and "Otherwise" after "If a player does" fail (each other player offered in turn order, CR 101.4; rulings: a continuous replacement of each draw, one card at a time; a paid card goes from the library to the graveyard, never drawn)

text: If a cycling ability of another nonland card would cause you to draw a card, instead exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a card that shares a card type with the cycled card. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Then put the exiled cards that weren't cast this way on the bottom of your library in a random order.
failing_piece: If a cycling ability of another nonland card would cause you to draw a card, instead exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a card that shares a card type with the cycled card.
note: drilled: the body (exile until a nonland card, cast it free, the rest on the bottom) compiles under "If you would draw a card" (C5-W-cyc-2); the cause "If a cycling ability [of another nonland card] would cause you to draw a card" fails with any body (C5-W-cyc-1, C5-W-cyc-3, C5-W-cyc-4), and so does "If a spell or ability would cause you to draw a card" (C5-W-cyc-8; Rain of Gore's "If a spell or ability would cause its controller to gain life" compiles); "shares a card type with the cycled card" fails in the replacement and in a cycle trigger (C5-W-cyc-7, C5-W-cyc-5, C5-W-cyc-6; "shares a card type with the exiled card" compiles: Semblance Anvil, Holistic Wisdom): the draw's cause (a cycling ability, CR 702.29) and the cycled card as a referent (rulings: any shared card type stops it; the card is cast during the resolution, timing ignored)
